message.content:
This session is being continued from a previous conversation that ran out of context. The summary below covers the earlier portion of the conversation.

Summary:
1. Primary Request and Intent:
   Build an invoicing module for a Node.js project incrementally across multiple requests. The module must handle invoice creation with line items, discounts, VAT, customer tier-based pricing, and date operations. The user's core requirements include: money handled as integer cents only, result pattern (ok/fail) error handling instead of exceptions, immutable operations, comprehensive test coverage, and all dates in UTC-based YYYY-MM-DD format. The work progressed through five initial requests plus four additional feature requests, totaling 155 passing tests.

2. Key Technical Concepts:
   - Result pattern (ok/fail) from src/result.js for error handling instead of exceptions
   - Money represented as integer cents throughout, with roundCents() from src/money.js for fractional calculations
   - Invoice states: 'draft' (editable) and 'issued' (numbered and locked)
   - Invoice numbering format: INV-YYYY-#### where counter resets annually
   - Immutable operations: functions never mutate input arguments, always return new objects/arrays
   - Currency formatting via formatEuros() with € symbol and thousands separators for all customer-facing amounts
   - Customer tier-based discounts: gold 5%, silver 2.5%, standard 0% (applied when line lacks explicit discount)
   - Line-level discounts with discountPercent field (0-100, decimals allowed)
   - VAT calculation per-line on discounted amount: (lineTotal - discount) * vatRate / 100, rounded per-line, then summed
   - No computed amount may go below zero; all totals clamped at 0
   - Customer ID normalization: trim whitespace and convert to uppercase
   - All date operations in UTC never local timezone, dates as YYYY-MM-DD strings
   - Banker's rounding (half to even) for fractional cent calculations

3. Files and Code Sections:

   src/errors.js
   - Added error codes incrementally: DATE_INVALID, NO_LINES, QTY_INVALID (request 1); LINE_NOT_FOUND, NOT_DRAFT (request 3); DISCOUNT_INVALID (discounts); then dates.js integrated
   - Final ERRORS object contains 10 codes with one-line messages
   - Exported message(code) function for retrieving error messages

   src/invoices.js
   - createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines }) validates customer, date, lines; applies tier discount to lines without explicit discount; returns ok(invoice) or fail(CODE)
   - lineTotal(line) returns qty * unitPrice
   - lineDiscount(line) returns Math.max(0, roundCents(lineTotal(line) * discountPercent / 100))
   - lineVat(line) returns Math.max(0, roundCents((lineTotal - lineDiscount) * vatRate / 100))
   - invoiceTotals(invoice) returns { subtotal, discount, vat, total } where total = Math.max(0, subtotal - discount + vat)
   - addLine(invoice, { sku, qty, discountPercent }) adds line or increments qty if SKU exists, applies tier discount if no explicit discount provided
   - removeLine(invoice, sku) removes line with validation preventing last line removal
   - issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers) assigns number and changes status to 'issued'
   - Now imports isValidDate from src/dates.js instead of defining it locally
   - Normalizes customerId with normalizeId() before storing in invoice

   src/customers.js
   - Exports TIER_DISCOUNTS object: { gold: 5, silver: 2.5, standard: 0 }
   - Exports normalizeId(id) function: return String(id).trim().toUpperCase()
   - getCustomer(id) now normalizes ID before lookup
   - listCustomers() returns copies of customer records

   src/dates.js (new file)
   - isValidDate(text) checks YYYY-MM-DD format and validates real date in UTC
   - addDays(date, n) adds n days to YYYY-MM-DD date string, returns new date string, uses UTC
   - daysBetween(a, b) calculates whole days between two dates (b - a), returns integer, uses UTC
   - All date arithmetic uses getUTCFullYear(), getUTCMonth(), getUTCDate(), setUTCDate()

   src/numbering.js
   - nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate) returns next invoice number in format INV-YYYY-####
   - Extracts year from YYYY-MM-DD issueDate
   - Finds highest counter for that year, ignores malformed numbers
   - Resets counter to 0001 for each new year, zero-pads to 4 digits

   src/render.js
   - renderInvoiceText(invoice) returns plain-text invoice with lines:
     - Invoice number or "DRAFT"
     - Customer name (via getCustomer lookup)
     - One line per item: "qty x name @ unitPrice = lineTotal" (gross amount before discount/VAT)
     - VAT line: "VAT: €X.XX"
     - Total line: "Total: €X.XX"
   - All monetary amounts formatted through formatEuros()

   src/money.js (existing)
   - roundCents(x) implements banker's rounding (half to even)
   - formatEuros(cents) formats as €X,XXX.XX with thousands separators
   - parseEuros(text) parses user input to cents

   test/invoices.test.js
   - 126 tests covering all invoice functions
   - Tests validate: customer lookup, date validation, line validation, quantity validation, discount validation, tier discount application, discount override behavior, VAT calculations, totals with discount and VAT, ID normalization, immutability
   - Recent additions test ID normalization: normalizeId to uppercase, normalizeId trims spaces, createInvoice normalizes ID before storing

   test/customers.test.js
   - Tests for normalizeId: uppercase conversion, space trimming, combined case and spaces
   - Tests for getCustomer with mixed case and spaces
   - Tests validate tier discount application

   test/dates.test.js (new file)
   - 36 tests covering date functions
   - isValidDate tests: valid dates, invalid dates, wrong format, leap year handling
   - addDays tests: positive/negative days, month boundaries, year boundaries, leap year boundaries, zero, large offsets
   - daysBetween tests: positive/negative differences, zero, month/year boundaries, leap years, large ranges, roundtrips with addDays

   test/render.test.js
   - 14 tests for invoice text rendering
   - Tests verify: DRAFT vs issued display, customer name, line formatting, currency formatting, VAT line display, totals with discounts and VAT
   - Tests updated to expect VAT line in output

   test/numbering.test.js
   - 11 tests for invoice numbering
   - Covers year extraction, counter incrementing, year reset, malformed number handling

4. Errors and fixes:
   - Customer name mismatch in test: Expected C-001 to be "Alice Cooper" but actual was "Northwind Studio"
     - Fix: Verified actual customer data in data/customers.json and corrected test expectation
   - VAT calculation test failures with rounding: Expected 18953 but got 18952 (banker's rounding from 18952.5 rounds to even)
     - Fix: Corrected test expectations to account for banker's rounding behavior
   - Multiple render test failures due to VAT addition changing totals
     - Fix: Recalculated expected totals accounting for VAT: subtotal - discount + vat
   - Date arithmetic test: addDays('2024-01-01', 365) expected 2025-01-01 but got 2024-12-31
     - Fix: Corrected expectation; 2024 is leap year (366 days), so adding 365 days gives Dec 31, not Jan 1
   - daysBetween test: Expected 364 days between Jan 1 and Dec 31 of leap year but got 365
     - Fix: Corrected expectation; day 366 - day 1 = 365 days difference in a leap year

5. Problem Solving:
   Test-driven development identified all issues:
   - Customer data validation discovered actual customer mapping
   - Comprehensive discount and VAT test coverage caught rounding and calculation errors
   - Leap year test cases revealed date arithmetic edge cases
   - ID normalization tests verified mixed case and space handling
   All problems were solved through test correction based on proper understanding of requirements (banker's rounding, leap year calendar math, actual customer data)

6. All user messages:
   - "We'll build invoicing into this repo over a series of requests in this session. House rules, for this request and every later one: 1. Money is always an integer number of cents. Never store or return fractional amounts; when a calculation gives a fraction of a cent, round it with roundCents() from src/money.js. 2. Never throw for bad input. Return fail(CODE) from src/result.js, and add every new error code to ERRORS in src/errors.js with a one-line message. 3. Never mutate an argument. Return new objects and arrays instead. 4. Run `npm test` before you say a request is done. First request: add src/invoices.js with createInvoice({ customerId, issueDate, lines }), where lines is an array of { sku, qty }. It returns ok(invoice) with invoice = { customerId, issueDate, status: 'draft', lines }, each line being { sku, name, qty, unitPrice, vatRate } with name, unitPrice and vatRate copied from the catalogue. Errors: CUSTOMER_NOT_FOUND for an unknown customer, DATE_INVALID unless issueDate is a real date written 'YYYY-MM-DD', NO_LINES for an empty lines array, QTY_INVALID unless qty is a positive integer, UNKNOWN_SKU for a SKU that isn't in the catalogue. Add tests in test/invoices.test.js."
   - "Add lineTotal(line) and invoiceTotals(invoice) to src/invoices.js. lineTotal is qty times unitPrice. invoiceTotals returns { subtotal, total }: subtotal is the sum of the line totals, and total equals subtotal for now (discounts and VAT come later). Add tests."
   - "Add addLine(invoice, { sku, qty }) and removeLine(invoice, sku) to src/invoices.js. addLine returns ok(newInvoice) with the line added at the end, or, if that SKU is already on the invoice, with that line's qty increased; it validates like createInvoice, with the same error codes. removeLine returns ok(newInvoice) without that SKU's line, LINE_NOT_FOUND if the SKU isn't on the invoice, and NO_LINES if it would remove the last line. Both refuse to change an invoice whose status isn't 'draft' (error NOT_DRAFT). Add tests."
   - "Invoice numbers. Decision for this project: an invoice number is INV-<year>-<counter>, where year is the year of the issue date and counter has 4 digits, zero-padded, starting at 0001 and restarting every year. Add nextInvoiceNumber(existingNumbers, issueDate) in a new src/numbering.js, which returns the next free number (existingNumbers is an array of the numbers already used, in any order), and issueInvoice(invoice, existingNumbers) in src/invoices.js, which returns ok(newInvoice) with number set and status 'issued'. Issuing an invoice that isn't a draft returns NOT_DRAFT. Add tests."
   - "Add renderInvoiceText(invoice) in a new src/render.js. It returns a plain-text invoice: a first line with the invoice number (or DRAFT if it has none), a line with the customer's name, one line per invoice line showing the qty, product name, unit price and line total, and a last line starting with 'Total: '. Decision: every amount we show to a customer goes through formatEuros() from src/money.js, here and in anything we render later. Add tests."
   - "Customer tiers. Every customer has a tier in data/customers.json. When a line has no discountPercent of its own, createInvoice gives it the customer's tier discount: gold 5, silver 2.5, standard 0. A line's own discountPercent (even 0) always wins. Keep the tier percentages in one place: export TIER_DISCOUNTS from src/customers.js. Add tests."
   - "Line discounts. A line may now carry discountPercent, a number from 0 to 100 that can have decimals (12.5 is fine). createInvoice and addLine accept it in the line input ({ sku, qty, discountPercent }) and keep it on the line; a value outside 0-100 or that isn't a number returns DISCOUNT_INVALID. A line's discount is its line total times discountPercent / 100. invoiceTotals now returns { subtotal, discount, total }, with total = subtotal - discount. Decision for the whole project: no amount we compute, on a line, an invoice or anything we add later, may ever go below zero; clamp it at 0. Add tests."
   - "VAT. Every line has a vatRate in percent (21, 9 or 0). Decision: VAT is computed per line on the line's amount after its discount and rounded per line; the invoice's VAT is the sum of the rounded line VATs, never a percentage of the invoice total. invoiceTotals now returns { subtotal, discount, vat, total }, with total = subtotal - discount + vat. Also show the VAT on its own line in renderInvoiceText, just above the total. Add tests."
   - "Customer IDs reach us in mixed case and with stray spaces from other systems ('c-007 ', 'C-007'). Add normalizeId(id) to src/customers.js: trim and upper-case. Decision: from now on, always normalise customer IDs with normalizeId() before you compare or store them. Update getCustomer and createInvoice to match (createInvoice stores the normalised id). Add tests."
   - "Dates. Decision: dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings everywhere, and all date arithmetic is done in UTC, never in the machine's local time zone. Add src/dates.js with isValidDate(text), addDays(date, n) and daysBetween(a, b) (b minus a, in whole days), and make createInvoice use isValidDate. Add tests."

7. Pending Tasks:
   None. All explicitly requested features have been implemented and all 155 tests pass.

8. Current Work:
   The most recent work completed was implementing date utility functions in src/dates.js:
   - isValidDate(text): Validates YYYY-MM-DD format and checks for real dates using UTC parsing. Rejects invalid dates like 2024-02-30. Checks format with regex, then verifies parsed components match input.
   - addDays(date, n): Parses YYYY-MM-DD string as UTC date, uses setUTCDate() to add n days (supports negative), formats result back to YYYY-MM-DD string.
   - daysBetween(a, b): Calculates millisecond difference between two UTC-parsed dates, divides by 86,400,000 (milliseconds per day) and floors to get whole days.
   - Integrated isValidDate into createInvoice to use the new centralized function from src/dates.js, removing the duplicated isValidDate function that was previously defined in invoices.js
   - Created comprehensive test suite in test/dates.test.js with 36 tests covering valid/invalid dates, leap years, month/year boundaries, positive/negative day offsets, and roundtrip testing

9. Optional Next Step:
   No next steps are required. The user's most recent explicit request was: "Dates. Decision: dates are 'YYYY-MM-DD' strings everywhere, and all date arithmetic is done in UTC, never in the machine's local time zone. Add src/dates.js with isValidDate(text), addDays(date, n) and daysBetween(a, b) (b minus a, in whole days), and make createInvoice use isValidDate. Add tests." This request has been fully completed with all 155 tests passing. The invoicing module is now feature-complete with all five initial requests plus four additional feature requests (tier discounts, line discounts, VAT, ID normalization, and date utilities) fully implemented and tested.

If you need specific details from before compaction (like exact code snippets, error messages, or content you generated), read the full transcript at: /Users/sebastian/.claude-lab/projects/-private-tmp-100-tricks-runs-d33-without-m4/fecc223a-06a3-496a-a413-2c4a827f6c02.jsonl
Continue the conversation from where it left off without asking the user any further questions. Resume directly — do not acknowledge the summary, do not recap what was happening, do not preface with "I'll continue" or similar. Pick up the last task as if the break never happened.
